englishTranslation: Boiled pork with rice paper rolls
atAGlance: Thịt luộc cuốn bánh tráng is boiled pork rolled with rice paper, herbs, noodles, cucumber, green banana, and often mắm nêm or nước chấm.
whatItIs: Thịt luộc cuốn bánh tráng is a roll-your-own boiled pork plate. The pork is intentionally simple because rice paper, herbs, noodles, cucumber, green banana, and a strong dip complete the bite.
howToEnjoy: Soften rice paper if needed, layer pork, herbs, noodles, and cucumber, then roll and dip. Start lightly with mắm nêm because the fermented anchovy flavor can be powerful.
howLocalsOrder: Order thịt luộc cuốn bánh tráng for a fresh roll-it-yourself meal. Ask for extra bánh tráng, extra herbs, or nước chấm instead of mắm nêm if you want a milder dip.
worthKnowing: This dish shows why Vietnamese “plain” pork is not plain at the table: herbs, rice paper, green banana, and fermented dip turn it into a bright meal.
commonOptions: nước chấm instead of mắm nêm

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần thịt luộc cuốn bánh tráng.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of boiled pork with rice paper rolls.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht fuhn tit loo-uk kwun bahn chang
